text:
jonathan: FYI opened a PR to change KMS/HSM audit log config for key rotation + authz rules. needs security eyes before we merge. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4823 :eyes:

maya: quick summary of the authz delta? I can take a first pass if it's small

jonathan: sure — main changes: tighten `kms:Encrypt` scope for rotation service account, add explicit `kms:AuditLog` entries for `KeyRotate` events, bump retention for audit logs to 90d in prod. also a migration that flips a feature flag `hsm_audit_compat` on. tests cover migration.

akshay: does the migration touch the DB schema or just config? if db, what's the rollback plan?

jonathan: only config + a small audit index create in our metadb. rollback is idempotent: index creation is noop if exists, and flag flip can be reverted. added a short rollback section in the PR description.

ci-bot: build passed — unit 128/128, integration smoke ✅ (artifact: gs://redwood-ci/4823/build-1810000000)

elaine: tagging to request formal security review @compliance-team. two asks: (1) confirm `kms:AuditLog` events are exhaustive for rotation paths, (2) confirm retention change meets legal's instruction. also want a quick threat model note in the PR. :white_check_mark:

jonathan: added threat-model snippet and event list in the PR body. pinging @elaine for any missing events.

maya: one nit — in the config diff you left `retention_days: 90` under `staging` by accident, should be under `production`. small patch incoming.

jonathan: fixed and pushed. diff snippet:

```
- staging:
-   retention_days: 90
+ production:
+   retention_days: 90
```

akshay: ran the migration locally, looks good. approving the PR from infra side.

elaine: I can do the security approval after one more quick check: please add the audit event schema example (json) to the PR so legal can verify. once that's in I'll post LGTM.

jonathan: added sample event payload and linked the legal checklist. thanks all. planning to merge in the afternoon window if we get final LGTM. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks — adding a note to the rollout doc about monitoring alert thresholds for increased audit traffic.

elaine: LGTM from security after seeing the sample event. merge when ready, prefer after 5pm PT to avoid morning pager noise. :ok_hand:

jonathan: merging after 17:00 PT. will follow up in #eng-oncall with rollout notes and alert watches.
